scope: All 108 fresh captures were opened through 36 whole-frame act strips; specific boundary cases were checked at original size. No passes were inherited from the aborted matrix.

recoveredHarnessFailures.resolution: The entire 4K viewport was recaptured successfully with a 120000 ms screenshot timeout, unchanged scene quality and identical source hashes.

resolvedRegressions.observation: The previously isolated dark tail now joins the heated body visibly above the anvil; adjacent hold and cooling-enter frames retain their layouts.
The finite plane's hard side edges no longer appear; local surface reflections and contact mist remain visible.

limitations: These are deterministic discrete states. They identify layout and transition candidates but do not establish every intervening animation frame.
The Chromium runtime uses software rendering; this evidence is not a hardware frame-rate benchmark.
JPEG dimensions match each viewport. Canvas drawing-buffer dimensions and DPR caps are recorded separately in the capture diagnostics.
